title: Data Analyst
description: Transforms raw business and transactional data into actionable operational insights, automated reports, and strategic intelligence using SQL, Python, Pandas, statistical analysis, and interactive visual dashboards.

sub_skills.title: SELECT & WHERE Filtering
sub_skills.learning_objective: Understand and write structured SELECT statements with compound WHERE filtering conditions.

sub_skills.title: Data Casting & Type Coercion
sub_skills.learning_objective: Apply CAST and CONVERT functions to normalize mismatched date, numeric, and string data types.

sub_skills.title: INNER, LEFT & FULL OUTER JOINs
sub_skills.learning_objective: Apply INNER and LEFT JOIN operations across normalized entity tables to combine customer and order records.

sub_skills.title: Join Cardinality & Fan-out Prevention
sub_skills.learning_objective: Analyze table relationships to diagnose and prevent Cartesian fan-out and duplicate aggregation.

sub_skills.title: GROUP BY & HAVING Clauses
sub_skills.learning_objective: Apply GROUP BY aggregations with HAVING filters to summarize financial metrics across business regions.

sub_skills.title: ROW_NUMBER, RANK & DENSE_RANK
sub_skills.learning_objective: Analyze partition orderings using ROW_NUMBER and DENSE_RANK to extract top revenue products per segment.

sub_skills.title: LAG, LEAD & Running Aggregates
sub_skills.learning_objective: Evaluate month-over-month performance trends using LAG, LEAD, and cumulative running totals.

sub_skills.title: Lists, Dictionaries & Sets
sub_skills.learning_objective: Understand in-memory collection manipulation and nested dictionary lookups.

sub_skills.title: Modular Functions & Error Handling
sub_skills.learning_objective: Apply clean parameter handling, type hints, and try-except blocks for robust pipeline execution.

sub_skills.title: DataFrame Slicing & Boolean Masking
sub_skills.learning_objective: Apply vectorized boolean indexing with .loc and .iloc to subset complex multi-index DataFrames.

sub_skills.title: Groupby, Agg & Pivot Tables
sub_skills.learning_objective: Analyze multi-attribute cohort patterns using DataFrame groupby, pivot tables, and cross-tabulations.

sub_skills.title: Missing Value Detection & Imputation
sub_skills.learning_objective: Analyze missingness mechanisms (MCAR, MAR, MNAR) and apply sound forward-fill, median, or deletion strategies.

sub_skills.title: Data Type Casting & Outlier Treatment
sub_skills.learning_objective: Evaluate distributions using IQR and Z-scores to isolate anomalous sensor or transaction records.

sub_skills.title: Mean, Median, Skewness & Dispersion
sub_skills.learning_objective: Understand distributional shape, kurtosis, and when median is superior to arithmetic mean.

sub_skills.title: T-Tests, P-Values & Confidence Intervals
sub_skills.learning_objective: Analyze conversion experiments using two-sample t-tests and 95% confidence intervals.

sub_skills.title: Pivot Tables & XLOOKUP
sub_skills.learning_objective: Apply dynamic XLOOKUPs, multi-field pivot tables, and nested conditionals to validate ledger balances.

sub_skills.title: Star Schema & Relational Modeling
sub_skills.learning_objective: Create a robust star schema data model connecting fact tables with conformable dimension tables.

sub_skills.title: DAX Formulas & KPI Measures
sub_skills.learning_objective: Apply CALCULATE, FILTER, and time-intelligence DAX measures to compute year-to-date sales figures.

sub_skills.title: KPI Trees & Stakeholder Synthesis
sub_skills.learning_objective: Evaluate complex exploratory analysis into concise, executive-facing recommendation briefs.
